sentences.en: The court condemned the man to death by lethal injection.
sentences.zh: 法院判处那人注射死刑。

sentences.en: His fart was so lethal that I nearly passed out.
sentences.zh: 他的放屁太致命了，我都差点晕过去了。

sentences.en: He was sentenced to a lethal ingestion of carbs.
sentences.zh: 他被判处大量摄入碳水化合物的惩罚。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：leth（遗忘）+al→致命的伤害就是被彻底遗忘→致命的
